snippet.title: No Place for Bravery | Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Announced at IGN Expo, No Place for Bravery is coming to PC and Switch on September 22nd, 2022! 

No Place For Bravery is a top-down action RPG that explores the lengths a parent would go to find their child in a war-torn world. 
www.noplaceforbravery.com

Wishlist us on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1039100/No_Place_for_Bravery/

Wanna chat about No Place for Bravery? 
Throw us a follow on Twitter @GlitchFTY and @YsbrydGames
